environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9 runtime, x86_64) deployed behind API Gateway REST API with no request validation. Lambda execution role has AmazonDynamoDBReadOnlyAccess. API Gateway has no request header filtering, method request models are set to passthrough. Lambda /tmp has default 512MB ephemeral storage with standard permissions. No Lambda extensions or layers modifying runtime behavior. Warm container reuse is enabled (default).
